scope: Independent paragraph-by-paragraph review of the two frozen section-15 first-half contribution sources and actual reinspection of French physical pages 91–93. This is not a review of all historical proofs in the book and is not final integrated PDF QA.

findings.reason: The finite-type image f(Z) is constructible and contains a nonempty open U of its irreducible closure T. Noether normalization of an affine open inside U supplies an m-dimensional closed irreducible W of T meeting U. Smooth surjective q with irreducible fibers gives irreducible q^{-1}(W); its nonempty open over W∩U remains dominant over G by axiom (A). The surjection from f^{-1}(U)∩Z survives base change and yields dominance of mathcal Z over G.

Only irreducible components Zi with dim f(Zi)≥m survive in the generic fiber; their generic points remain distinct and cannot be contained in another component. The maximum of dim Zi−m over surviving components is correct. P¹⊔A² with identity and constant maps provides the stated finite-type counterexample to the unconditional dim Z−m formula.

The dual-number example satisfies the initial geometric-irreducibility and nonemptiness axioms but gives a nonflat regular-point generic section over a nonregular point. Generic reducedness of irreducible G makes Spec k(eta)→G locally a localization. Its base change and composition with smooth q_X give a flat map with geometrically regular, locally Noetherian fibers. This is a sufficient repair for the regular-morphism premise; it does not by itself verify every claim in 2.1–2.11.

The reviewed Chinese text distinguishes author deletion, English transcription errors, restored underlines, added arrow labels, finite-type hypotheses, nonempty geometric fibers, and translator mathematical supplements. The original French 4/6 versus later 3/6 numbering is retained and attributed rather than silently harmonized.
The already reported literal ,quad in axiom (A) has been corrected to ,\quad in the frozen audit source; the expected corrected source SHA was verified directly.

overall_result: No additional mathematical or source-attribution revision requested. Final integrated PDF visual QA is still to be performed separately.
